things.label: An iron bed
things.text: Whoever lay here stopped speaking in the night. The sheet is turned back with great care, as if for someone who might come back to it.
things.res: A folded note in a nurse's hand: 'Stopped speaking 3.07. Smiling. Did not wake.'

things.text: Trimmed low. Beside it a cup of tea gone cold, and a chair nobody has sat in since midnight.

things.label: The sister's desk
things.text: A ward register, a pen, a watch pinned to a blotter. The last entry is half a line long.
things.res: Forty-one names in three weeks. Each with a note: 'Quiet from' and a time an hour earlier.

things.label: The stove
things.text: Banked down. Something has been burned in it lately: paper, and a little cloth.
things.res: A scrap of paper, scorched: '...please. Somebody. Hear me say it.'

things.label: A gramophone
things.text: A trophy of Ward 6. A record is on it: a music-hall song, very loud.
things.res: It plays, dreadfully, at full volume. Along the ward, forty heads turn. For a moment it is not quiet at all.
